actualError: CpfOpenApiAutoConfiguration.cpfOpenApiOperations parameter 1 requires a single RequestMappingHandlerMapping but found requestMappingHandlerMapping and controllerEndpointHandlerMapping.
rootCauseHypothesis: The OpenAPI consumer uses type-only injection even though it semantically owns application business mappings, not the Actuator management controller mapping introduced on the same application context.
priorFindingImpact: Neither former F127 AOP exception appears; F127 remains VERIFICATION_PENDING and this independent failure is F128.
requiredFix: Select the canonical application requestMappingHandlerMapping at the OpenAPI Owner and add a regression with multiple mapping beans. Do not remove Actuator or relax Spring ambiguity checks.
